business_problem: Jodoo needed to handle massive data volumes, dynamic user-defined fields, and remain competitive in the fast-growing low-code/no-code market.
solution_summary: Jodoo needed to handle massive data volumes, dynamic user-defined fields, and remain competitive in the fast-growing low-code/no-code market. MongoDB’s flexible schema, elastic scaling, and real-time data processing simplified enterprise app building and boosted innovation. Using intuitive tools such as templates, clicks, and drag-and-drop, Jodoo helps quickly turn managerial ideas into functional apps. Through tailor-made training programs, Jodoo has empowered over 300 medium and large enterprises to train nearly 15,000 skilled digital professionals. The challenge is now to leverage the agility of low-code/no-code platforms to improve operational efficiencies and drive business growth. To meet rising demand for scalable and customized enterprise applications, platforms must seamlessly integrate with internal and external systems using open APIs. However, rapid market growth also brings technical challenges.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Provides the managed document database backing Jodoo's modernized application platform.

data_flow: Operational data from legacy or distributed applications is consolidated in MongoDB Atlas, where flexible document models support microservices, APIs, and downstream user experiences without batch-heavy synchronization. Upstream and downstream integrations include APIs, data lake.
business_outcome: Jodoo achieved 30% DBA workload savings, reduced RTO from 8 hours to 30 minutes, and enabled automated elastic scaling.
metrics: Jodoo achieved 30% DBA workload savings, reduced RTO from 8 hours to 30 minutes, and enabled automated elastic scaling.
